summary: CastleLoader (aka CastleBot) is a Windows malware loader distributed through paste-and-run (fake CAPTCHA/ClickFix) campaigns that use caret-obfuscated cmd.exe and finger.exe command lines to fetch batch and Python code. It uses a Bring-Your-Own-Interpreter chain (portable CPython/IronPython) with Base64/zlib/UTF-32 triple-encoded shellcode that injects the RC4-decrypted loader into python.exe, then beacons to C2 for configuration and payloads such as NetSupport Manager, CastleRAT, and a .NET infostealer.
